title: Two Margins of Climate Cooperation: Emissions and Coalition Membership under Tipping
abstract: arXiv:2506.16162v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study climate coalition stability with endogenous temperature and stochastic tipping. In our dynamic game, rising temperature widens the emissions gap between members and nonmembers, shrinking stable coalitions over time. The threat of tipping strengthens free-riding, raising emissions and reducing coalition size; its occurrence also contracts coalitions numerically. Advanced regions form the core, while emerging & developing regions drive membership variation. Comparing policy instruments, connection (internal incentives) and sanctions (external penalties) sustain similar coalitions, but connection raises aggregate payoffs, whereas sanctions achieve larger emissions cuts. As tipping approaches, this trade-off intensifies, making the optimal institutional design state-dependent.

translated_title: 气候合作的两个边际：临界点下的排放与联盟成员变动
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有内生温度和随机临界点的气候联盟稳定性问题。在我们的动态博弈中，气温上升扩大了成员国与非成员国之间的排放差距，使稳定联盟随时间不断缩小。临界点的威胁会加剧搭便车行为，导致排放增加、联盟规模缩减；而临界点的实际发生也在数量上使联盟进一步收缩。发达地区构成联盟的核心，而新兴和发展中地区则是成员变动的驱动因素。在政策工具的比较上，联结（内部激励）与制裁（外部惩罚）能够维持规模相近的联盟，但联结能提高总收益，而制裁则能实现更大幅度的减排。随着临界点临近，这种权衡愈发激烈，使得最优制度设计取决于系统状态。
tldr: 该论文构建了包含内生温度与随机临界点的动态气候博弈模型，揭示出临界点威胁会加剧搭便车并使气候联盟萎缩，且“联结”与“制裁”两种制度工具存在总收益与减排幅度之间的权衡，因此最优制度设计应随状态动态调整。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a dynamic climate game with endogenous temperature and stochastic tipping, showing that the threat of tipping strengthens free-riding and shrinks stable coalitions, and that connection versus sanctions involve a trade-off between aggregate payoffs and emissions cuts, making optimal institutional design state-dependent.
